newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japanese engineer wounded in Cambodia fighting.
newsitem.headline: Japanese engineer wounded in Cambodia fighting.

text.p: A 38-year-old Japanese road engineer was wounded in the current outbreak of fighting in Phnom Penh, a Japanese Foreign Ministry official said on Sunday.
The official said a rocket hit the office-home where Takamasa Okajima lived on Saturday.
He was in hospital in a critical condition.
Okajima worked for Tokyo-based Oriental Consultancy and had been in Phnom Penh since May.
He was taking part in a road-building project funded by Japanese government aid.
Cable News Network (CNN) estimates there are currently some 8,000 foreign nationals in the Cambodian capital.
